full_name: Shawon Kinew | Radcliffe Institute for Advanced Study at Harvard University
title: 2020–2021 Humanities Shutzer Assistant Professor Harvard University
bio: Shawon Kinew is an art historian of early modern Italy at Harvard University, where she is an assistant professor in the Department of History of Art and Architecture. Kinew is a Shutzer Assistant Professor at the Radcliffe Institute.
